name: professor
label: Professor
pitch: EverythingProfessor-style list explainer: one bald cartoon everyman on a mustard-yellow world acts out every sentence; each item is a chapter.
title_examples: Every Mental Disorder & Their Effects Explained
Every Financial Trap Middle Class People Fall Into Explained
Simply Explaining Complex Things You Always Wondered

image.prefix: Flat 2D cartoon illustration in exactly the same art style as the reference image: thick clean black outlines, flat vivid colors, very soft minimal shading, plain solid mustard-yellow (#F7C325) background with no gradient, no texture, no photorealism.
image.character: When the main character appears he is EXACTLY the character from the reference image: bald round head, big round white eyes with small black pupils, small ears, pale peach skin, simple body. In this chapter he wears: {outfit}. Other people are drawn in the same simple style with different hair and clothes.
image.composition: 16:9 landscape composition. Keep the top 14% of the frame completely empty plain yellow background because a title will be placed there. Big, simple, readable subject; at most a few props; the background stays plain yellow except for a simple floor or furniture when the scene needs it.
image.text_none: Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, or words anywhere in the image.
image.text_some: The only text allowed in the image is: {text} — spelled exactly like that, in bold black capital letters. No other text.
image.icon: A single simple flat cartoon icon of {icon}, thick black outlines, vivid flat colors, centered, isolated on a plain pure white background, nothing else, no text, no circle, no border.
